id.description: Position in the whole answer (L1 is the most frequent group).

message.description: The exact logged message; untrusted data.

secrets_redacted.description: Authentication secrets inside the message were replaced.

message_exact.description: message is the stored text unchanged and works as the message filter of operational_log_events; false when a secret was replaced or a format character made visible. Then filter the events by instance and the group's buckets instead.

status.description: A counted message is an observation, never an incident.

symptom.description: Diagnostics symptom code of a profiled message.

counts.description: One count per entry of buckets.
